displayName: OCI-API-014: API — Excessive Data Exposure in Response
description:
Detects API responses returning more data than requested including PII, credentials, or internal fields

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: api — excessive data exposure in response

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_014", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" IN ('UpdateApiKey', 'UploadApiKey', 'CreateApiKey', 'DeleteApiKey') AND "value" > 0
